exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

I eat cottage cheese regularly and want to minimize cost per serving. Which brand should I buy, and why?
reviewed_answer:
My recommendation: Buy Great Value 4% Small Curd Cottage Cheese from Walmart in the 48-ounce tub. It's one of the cheapest widely available options I found in the U.S., and its larger size makes it especially economical for someone who eats cottage cheese regularly.

Great Value 4% Milkfat Minimum Small Curd Cottage Cheese, 48…
$5.24

48 oz · Walmart · approximately 12 servings

About $0.44 per ½-cup serving

12g protein per serving · 4.7/5 customer rating

Why it wins: it combines a low price per ounce, a large container that avoids paying extra for smaller packages, and a reasonable protein content. You don't need to pay a premium for a nationally advertised brand to get a protein-rich cottage cheese.

Why I'd choose Great Value

Consistent savings: At one ½-cup serving daily, the 48-ounce Great Value tub costs about $13.10 per 30 days, versus $22.43 for Daisy's 48-ounce tub at the listed prices. That's roughly $112 saved annually.

Good protein value: Each serving supplies about 12g of protein, or approximately 3.6 cents per gram of protein.

No membership required: Unlike warehouse-club options, Walmart doesn't require a paid membership.

Easy to buy repeatedly: The smaller 24-ounce Great Value tub is also competitively priced when the 48-ounce version is unavailable.

One important caveat

The biggest tub isn't automatically cheapest if some goes to waste. A 48-ounce tub contains roughly 12 servings, so choose it only if you can finish it safely after opening, following the package's storage guidance.

If you prefer smaller packages, Great Value's 24-ounce tub at $2.87 would be my second choice. It's only about four cents more per serving.

Bottom line: For a frequent cottage cheese eater focused primarily on minimizing cost, Great Value is my pick. Check the shelf price per ounce at your local Walmart, and choose the 48-ounce tub when you can finish it without waste.
